{{Quote|You are now reborn a sister of the night! Welcome.|Mother Talzin, to Asajj Ventress|<ref name="Massacre">{{TCW|Massacre}}</ref>}}
'''Baptism''' was the ritual in which [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Gender/Legends|females]] became full members of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].

==The ceremony==
{{Quote|Do you pledge yourself to the sisterhood, to the magicks, and the old ways?''"<br />"''I do.''"<br />"''Do you abandon your old life for this new one?''"<br />"''Your loyalty, your life.''"<br />"''My loyalty, my life.|Mother Talzin questions Asajj Ventress during her baptism|<ref name="Massacre" />}}
The ceremony required a [[Shaman of the Nightsisters|Nightsister shaman]] and a full coven of spellcasters. Held in a dark [[Water/Legends|river]] in the [[Nightsister fortress]], the ceremony began with the [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] questioning the potential [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] on her loyalty to her clan. After the prospective [[Sister (Witches of Dathomir)|Sister]] had answered affirmatively to all questions, she would be submerged into the waters. The shaman would then draw forth [[Spirit ichor/Legends|spirit ichor]] as the spellcaster coven lifted her out of the waters. Once the Sister had been baptized in the magicks, she would be lowered, her [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] momentarily rising back into her skull before they returned to normal, signifying the beginning of her new life with the Nightsisters.

==History==
{{Quote|And now we feast and celebrate the baptism of our new sister!|Mother Talzin, following Ventress's baptism|<ref name="Massacre" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], who was born a Nightsister but spent her early life away from Dathomir, was baptized as a full Nightsister in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], shortly before the [[Battle of Dathomir/Legends|Battle of Dathomir]].
